description: The record of an agent's boundaries: permissions, sandbox, credentials, hooks, verifiers and loop limits, each tied to a fact in the briefing.
The worst outcome an agent's harness makes possible. Deny rules, scoped credentials and the sandbox shrink it.
Allow only the calls, paths, hosts and credentials the task needs; everything else asks or is denied.
The implementable part of the decision: rules, sandbox, hooks, verifiers and loop limits, precise enough to configure and test.
Iteration caps, failure limits and budgets that agree with each other, so the plan, not an accident, decides when a run stops.
